data.title: 守岸人 · 观测记录的书写
data.description: 观测站内，她在微光屏幕前记录潮汐与世界数据，指尖划过的地方泛起光纹；写到与某个人相关的条目时，笔迹出现了一丝只有数据才能看出的停顿。
data.action: 观测站内，她在微光屏幕前记录潮汐与世界数据，指尖划过的地方泛起光纹
data.promptProse: At the observation station, the Shorekeeper records tide and world data, fingertips leaving luminous traces across the display before pausing briefly over a familiar person's entry. Her pale-blue high-collared jacket and long white skirt remain orderly. The medium view includes the working screen and receding station consoles. Screen light reveals blue hair and attentive eyes, outlining the hand above the interface while the console edges behind remain in softer darkness.
